packs.name: Impossible architecture
packs.description: Dreamcore cities that break the rules: towers that twist, bridges that loop, streets that fold. One continuous camera drifts through one warping scene. Every idea is original to this studio.

ideas.title: Twisting towers
ideas.concept: A dense downtown whose glass towers corkscrew like wrung cloth, each floor rotated a little more than the one below, windows glinting in the dusk.
ideas.camera: Slow drift forward down the avenue, gently tilting up as the towers lean over the lens.
ideas.palette: steel blue, amber window glow, violet dusk sky

ideas.title: The bridge that loops
ideas.concept: A suspension bridge whose roadway curls up into a perfect vertical loop and rejoins itself, cables fanning around the circle, traffic lights glowing along the arc.
ideas.camera: Glide along the roadway as it rises into the loop, the horizon rotating slowly around the camera.
ideas.palette: orange sunset, teal water, white cables

ideas.title: The street that folds
ideas.concept: A quiet shopping street whose far end folds upward like a page, shopfronts and lamp posts hanging sideways above the pavement.
ideas.camera: Steady walk toward the fold, the buildings above slowly leaning in.
ideas.palette: warm brick, soft pink sky, lamp yellow

ideas.title: Stairs in the sky
ideas.concept: A stone staircase rising out of a rooftop garden straight up through the clouds, every landing a small floating plaza with a lamp.
ideas.camera: Climbing drift upward along the stairs, clouds streaming past the edges.
ideas.palette: cream stone, cloud white, pale gold

ideas.title: A city that forgot gravity
ideas.concept: A city street where the lower floors of buildings drift loose and float above the road, cars and trees hanging calmly a metre off the ground.
ideas.camera: Smooth glide forward just beneath the floating buildings, slight roll as they drift.
ideas.palette: grey concrete, soft green, morning haze

ideas.title: The upside-down skyline
ideas.concept: A calm riverfront under a second city hanging upside down in the clouds, its towers pointing down, its lights reflecting in the water.
ideas.camera: Slow tilt up from the river to the inverted skyline, then drift forward.
ideas.palette: indigo, city gold, mirror silver

ideas.title: The spiral boulevard
ideas.concept: A wide boulevard that coils upward around a giant central tower like a spring, with trams and street trees following the curve.
ideas.camera: Forward drift along the road as it climbs and curves, the tower turning in the corner of the frame.
ideas.palette: emerald, brass, blue hour

ideas.title: The melting clock tower
ideas.concept: A stone clock tower softening and drooping like warm wax over a plaza, its clock faces stretched, pigeons undisturbed.
ideas.camera: Slow orbiting drift around the leaning tower at eye level.
ideas.palette: sand, rose, dusty turquoise

ideas.title: The river in the air
ideas.concept: An old stone town where a wide river flows through the air overhead from rooftop to rooftop, sunlight rippling on the street below.
ideas.camera: Walk forward, camera tilting up to follow the water overhead.
ideas.palette: aqua, terracotta, warm sunlight

ideas.title: The street that curves up
ideas.concept: A neighbourhood street that curves upward on both sides until it becomes a ring overhead, houses and gardens all around the curve.
ideas.camera: Long forward glide, the horizon bending up ahead.
ideas.palette: pastel houses, green lawns, haze blue

ideas.title: The tilted metropolis
ideas.concept: An entire downtown tilted forty-five degrees like a plate, towers still standing straight out of the slope, tiny cars on the angled roads.
ideas.camera: Drift along the sloping avenue with a slight roll matching the tilt.
ideas.palette: slate, neon pink accents, dusk orange

ideas.title: The mirror canyon
ideas.concept: A narrow avenue where every building is perfectly mirrored on the opposite wall, then again on the ceiling of sky, endless reflected windows.
ideas.camera: Centred forward glide, perfectly smooth, symmetry holding.
ideas.palette: silver, ice blue, soft white

ideas.title: Bridges everywhere
ideas.concept: Skyscrapers linked by hundreds of crossing bridges at every height, a woven web of walkways glowing at golden hour.
ideas.camera: Weaving forward drift between the towers, passing under and over bridges.
ideas.palette: gold, deep blue, warm white

ideas.title: The tower that pours
ideas.concept: A glass tower with water streaming up its sides into the sky, a gentle reverse waterfall catching the light.
ideas.camera: Slow push toward the base, then a gentle tilt up following the water.
ideas.palette: glass green, white spray, sunrise pink

ideas.title: The floating district
ideas.concept: A whole city block torn loose and floating over the sea, roots of road and pipes trailing, tiny lights in every window.
ideas.camera: Approach from below, drifting up past the underside to the rooftops.
ideas.palette: deep teal, rust, warm window light

ideas.title: The twin spiral towers
ideas.concept: Two skyscrapers winding around each other like a double helix, sky bridges crossing where they touch.
ideas.camera: Slow upward drift around the helix, camera turning with it.
ideas.palette: pearl, cobalt, soft sunrise

ideas.title: The clockwork city
ideas.concept: Streets and plazas that rotate slowly like giant gears, meshing with neighbouring districts, rooftops and fountains turning in sync.
ideas.camera: Elevated forward drift over the turning districts.
ideas.palette: brass, copper, soft grey sky

ideas.title: The corridor of windows
ideas.concept: A hotel corridor whose windows open onto a different skyline each, the carpet running out into a street at the far end.
ideas.camera: Calm forward walk down the corridor, each window sliding past.
ideas.palette: warm carpet red, night blue, neon

ideas.title: The sky that sank
ideas.concept: A low bank of cloud pouring down between the buildings like a slow river, streets flooded with soft white, lamp posts glowing through it.
ideas.camera: Gentle drift forward into the cloud, buildings emerging and fading.
ideas.palette: cloud white, lamp amber, pale blue

ideas.title: The village on the wall
ideas.concept: A village built on the face of a vertical cliff of glass, gardens and windows hanging out sideways, ladders and lights between homes.
ideas.camera: Slow upward drift along the wall at arm's length.
ideas.palette: garden green, warm yellow, sky blue

ideas.title: The knotted highway
ideas.concept: An elevated highway that twists into a giant knot above the city, lanes weaving through each other, tail lights streaming.
ideas.camera: Forward drift along the road into the knot, the lanes crossing overhead.
ideas.palette: red tail lights, steel, night violet

ideas.title: The paper skyline
ideas.concept: A skyline of buildings that unfold from flat paper-thin panels into towers as the sun rises, edges crisp, creases visible.
ideas.camera: Slow rise forward as each tower unfolds in turn.
ideas.palette: paper white, peach, soft grey

ideas.title: The leaning district
ideas.concept: Rows of buildings all leaning the same way at an impossible angle like wind-bent grass, tiny lit windows still level inside.
ideas.camera: Drift down the middle of the street between the leaning rows.
ideas.palette: ash blue, warm window light, mist

ideas.title: The city in the pool
ideas.concept: A bright tiled swimming hall where the pool's still water holds a full skyline underneath, towers rising up through the surface into the hall.
ideas.camera: Walk along the pool edge, camera lowering toward the water as towers rise.
ideas.palette: aqua tile, white, sunlit blue
